open_points.subject: A18 backup contents and AgentSession exclusion
open_points.text: The changed rule says “a later backup holds whatever the store holds when its own snapshot is taken,” while A18 rule 2 says “A backup holds every record but the agent sessions (M06), which are removed from the copy before it is encrypted.”
open_points.question: Does the statement that a backup holds whatever the snapshot contains have an exception for AgentSession records, or must those records remain in the backup?
options: Every backup excludes AgentSession records, so “whatever the store holds” means every otherwise backed-up record.
The backup preserves the snapshot exactly, including AgentSession records.
open_points.default_guess: Treat rule 2 as an explicit exception and exclude AgentSession records from every backup.

witness.initial: A prior backup exists, and the live store now contains registered agent session S with a granted project.
events: At the next daily run, Registry begins a snapshot while S is still present.
No session change occurs before the backup is checked, encrypted and kept.
The owner later restores that backup and Kernel queries or re-registers S.
outcomes: Under the changed sentence, the backup holds S because the store held S when the snapshot was taken; the restored store revives S and its grant.
Under A18 rule 2, S is removed before encryption; the restored store has no session or grant, and Kernel must register it again.
witness.observer: The owner and Cabinet Kernel after the restore
